title: Crying Faces in Ethereal Light
description: Four child-like faces with closed eyes and open mouths appear to be crying, with streams of tears flowing down. Their long, flowing white hair merges with abstract, dripping rainbow-colored ribbons and glowing particles against a luminous pale background.
